verdict.rationale: Linear's integrations directory lists a Figma integration that lets users create and link issues directly from Figma, so a designer can do some Linear work inside their design tool. Nothing shows that project or issue status can be viewed or updated from Figma, which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: updating issue or project status from inside Figma, two-way status sync back to the design tool, in-depth Figma integration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
